# Code of Conduct

This repository welcomes respectful, evidence-based academic collaboration.
Participants are expected to communicate professionally, review work
constructively and respect authorship, privacy and the course context.

Unacceptable conduct includes harassment, discrimination, personal attacks,
publication of private information, plagiarism, fabricated evidence and
misrepresentation of another person's contribution.

If a concern arises, use GitHub's reporting tools or contact a repository
maintainer privately. Share only the information needed to address the concern.
